sentences.en: Good morning.
sentences.zh: 早上好。

sentences.en: My name's Lucy Crittenden, and 'm the Director of Operations for an organisation that arranges volunteering in this part of the country.
sentences.zh: 我叫露西·克里滕登，是本地区一家志愿组织的运营总监。

sentences.en: I'm hoping I can persuade one or two of you to become volunteers yourselves.
sentences.zh: 我希望可以说服你们中的一两位成为志愿者。

sentences.en: Let me start by briefly explaining what we mean by volunteering.
sentences.zh: 首先，让我简要解释一下我们所说的‘志愿服务’是什么意思。

sentences.en: A E ou Volunteers are teenagers and adults who choose to spend some time, unpaid, helping other people in some way.
sentences.zh: 志愿者是选择无偿投入一定时间、以某种方式帮助他人的青少年和成年人。

sentences.en: Most volunteers devote two or three hours to this every week, while a few do much more.
sentences.zh: 大多数志愿者每周投入两到三个小时，少数人投入的时间则多得多。

sentences.en: The people they help may have physical or behavioural difficulties, for example.
sentences.zh: 他们所帮助的人可能有身体或行为方面的困难，例如。

sentences.en: Volunteers can do all sorts of things, depending on their own abilities and interests.
sentences.zh: 志愿者可以从事各种各样的工作，具体取决于他们自身的能力和兴趣。

sentences.en: If they're supporting a family that's struggling, for example, they may be able to give them tips on cooking, or recommend how to plan their budget or how to shop sensibly on their income.
sentences.zh: 例如，如果他们在支持一个陷入困境的家庭，就可能为他们提供烹饪小贴士，或建议如何规划家庭预算、如何根据收入理性购物。

sentences.en: They might even do some painting or wallpapering, perhaps alongside any members of the family who are able to do it.
sentences.zh: 他们甚至可能一起刷漆或贴墙纸，或许还能与家中有能力参与的成员一同完成。

sentences.en: Or even do some babysitting so that parents can go out for a while.
sentences.zh: 或者帮忙照看孩子，让父母能外出休息一段时间。

sentences.en: The benefit from volunteering isn't only for the people being helped.
sentences.zh: 志愿服务带来的益处并不仅限于受助者。

sentences.en: Volunteers also gain
sentences.zh: 志愿者自身也能从中获益：

sentences.en: from it: they're using their skills to cope with somebody's mental or physical ill health, and volunteering may be a valuable element of their CV when they're applying for jobs: employers 013 usually look favourably on someone who's given up time to help others.
sentences.zh: 他们运用自身技能应对他人心理或身体上的疾病；志愿服务经历也可能成为求职简历中宝贵的一环——雇主通常会青睐那些愿意抽出时间帮助他人的人。

sentences.en: Significantly, most volunteers feel that what they're doing gives them a purpose in their lives.
sentences.zh: 更重要的是，大多数志愿者感到自己所做的事情赋予了生活意义。

sentences.en: And in my opinion, they're lucky in that respect, as many people don't have that feeling.
sentences.zh: 在我看来，他们在这一点上很幸运，因为许多人并不具备这种感受。

sentences.en: Now I'd like to tell you what some of our volunteers have said about what they do, to give you an idea of the range of ways in which they can help people.
sentences.zh: 接下来，我想向大家介绍几位我们志愿者的亲身经历，以便让大家了解志愿服务所能涵盖的多种方式。

sentences.en: Habib supports an elderly lady who's beginning to show signs of dementia.
sentences.zh: 哈比卜为一位开始出现痴呆症迹象的老年女士提供支持。

sentences.en: Once a week they, along with other elderly people, go to the local community centre, where a group of people come in and sing.
sentences.zh: 每周一次，她和其他老年人一同前往当地社区中心，那里有一群人前来唱歌。

sentences.en: The songs take the listeners back to their youth, and for a little while they can forget the difficulties that they face now.
sentences.zh: 这些歌曲将听众带回青春岁月，使他们能暂时忘却当下所面临的困难。

sentences.en: Audioscripts Our volunteer Consuela is an amazing woman.
sentences.zh: 听力原文：我们的志愿者康苏埃拉是一位了不起的女性。

sentences.en: She has difficulty walking herself, but she doesn't let that stop her.
sentences.zh: 她自己行走有困难，但她并未因此止步。

sentences.en: She helps a couple of people with similar difficulties, who had almost stopped walking altogether.
sentences.zh: 她帮助几位面临类似困难、几乎已完全停止行走的人。

sentences.en: By using herself as an example, Consuela encourages them to walk more and more.
sentences.zh: 通过以自身为榜样，康苏埃拉鼓励他们逐步增加步行量。

sentences.en: Minh visits a young man who lives alone and can't leave his home on his own, so he hardly ever saw anyone.
sentences.zh: 明拜访一位独居且无法独自离家的年轻男子，因此他几乎从未见过任何人。

sentences.en: But together they go out to the cinema, or to see friends the young man hadn't been able to visit for a long time.
sentences.zh: 但如今他们一同去电影院，或探望那位年轻人已许久未能拜访的朋友。

sentences.en: Tanya visits an elderly woman once a week.
sentences.zh: 塔尼娅每周探访一位老年妇女一次。

sentences.en: When the woman found out that Tanya is a professional dressmaker, she got interested.
sentences.zh: 当这位女士得知塔尼娅是一名专业裁缝后，便产生了兴趣。

sentences.en: Tanya showed her some soft toys she'd made, and the woman decided to try it herself.
sentences.zh: 塔尼娅向她展示了一些自己制作的毛绒玩具，这位女士决定亲自尝试。

sentences.en: And now she really enjoys it, and spends hours making toys.
sentences.zh: 如今她对此非常着迷，花大量时间制作玩具。

sentences.en: They're not perhaps up to Tanya's standard yet, but she gains a lot of pleasure from doing it.
sentences.zh: 虽然目前成品或许还达不到塔尼娅的水准，但她从中获得了极大的乐趣。

sentences.en: Alexei is a volunteer with a family that faces a number of difficulties.
sentences.zh: 阿列克谢是一位服务于一个面临诸多困难家庭的志愿者。

sentences.en: By a calmly talking over possible solutions with family members, he's helping them to realise that they aren't helpless, and that they can do something themselves to improve their situation.
sentences.zh: 他通过冷静地与家庭成员共同探讨可能的解决方案，帮助他们认识到自己并非无能为力，而是能够主动采取行动改善现状。

sentences.en: This has been great for their self-esteem.
sentences.zh: 这对他们的自尊心提升大有裨益。

sentences.en: And the last volunteer I'll mention, though there are plenty more, is Juba.
sentences.zh: 最后我要提到的这位志愿者（当然还有许多其他志愿者）是朱巴。

sentences.en: She volunteers a with a teenage girl with learning difficulties, who wasn't very good at talking to other people.
sentences.zh: 她为一名有学习障碍的少女提供志愿服务，这名少女此前不擅长与他人交流。

sentences.en: Juba's worked very patiently with her, and now the girl is far better at expressing herself, and at understanding other people.
sentences.zh: 朱巴一直耐心地与她合作，如今这名少女在自我表达及理解他人方面已大有进步。

sentences.en: OK, I hope that's given you an idea of what volunteering is all about.
sentences.zh: 好的，希望以上介绍能让大家对志愿服务的内涵有所了解。
